verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Vue can be used dependency-free (single `vue.min.js` file, no bundler/package manager required) and adopted minimally into existing pages, supporting a light-footprint use case, but there is no first-party documentation citing actual bundle size figures, zero-dependency guarantees, or supply-chain risk mitigation. missing for 10: official bundle-size benchmarks, explicit zero-runtime-dependency documentation, tree-shaking/production-build size guidance, independent supply-chain risk analysis.
